d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Uruguay vs France in Group D of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. France claimed a 3-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Aymen Amaaouch and Aly Traore struck two minutes apart in the first half and Idrissa Dia added a third after the break. France topped Group D to qualify for the Round of 32.
